THREE_KINGDOMS-BING_LIANG_CUN_DUAN.title: Supply Shortage
THREE_KINGDOMS-BING_LIN_CHENG_XIA.title: At the Gates
THREE_KINGDOMS-BING_LIN_CHENG_XIA.descri: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Play all Slashes among them.
THREE_KINGDOMS-BI_YUE.title: Closed Moon
THREE_KINGDOMS-BI_YUE.description:
Draw cards equal to the number of Attacks played this turn, up to {DrawCardLimit:diff()}.
[blue]{AttackPlayed:diff()}[/blue] Attacks already played this turn.
THREE_KINGDOMS-CHENG_HAO.title: Praise
THREE_KINGDOMS-CHENG_HAO.description: Whenever you deal [gold]Elemental Damage[/gold] to a [gold]Chained[/gold] enemy, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
THREE_KINGDOMS-CHONG_ZHEN.title: Charge
THREE_KINGDOMS-CHONG_ZHEN.description: Discard the first [gold]Dodge[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold], then draw 1 card and deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
THREE_KINGDOMS-CHU_HAI.title: Eliminate Evil
THREE_KINGDOMS-CHU_HAI.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If [gold]Fatal[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a random card in your deck.
THREE_KINGDOMS-CUI_KE.title: Overwhelm
THREE_KINGDOMS-CUI_KE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} [gold]Elemental Damage[/gold] to an enemy, then make it [gold]Chained[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-DANG_GU.title: Proscription
THREE_KINGDOMS-DANG_GU.description:
At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and {Amount:diff()} random Power cards that cost 0 this combat.
[gold]Die after 5 turns (including this turn).[/gold]
[gold]Automatically played each combat.[/gold]
THREE_KINGDOMS-DANG_SHI.title: Momentum Sweep
THREE_KINGDOMS-DANG_SHI.description: Whenever you play an Attack this turn, deal 3 damage to a random enemy and apply 1 [gold]Weak[/gold] to the leftmost enemy.
THREE_KINGDOMS-DUAN_JIN.title: Cut the Ford
THREE_KINGDOMS-DUAN_JIN.description: Whenever you play a [gold]Basic[/gold] card, apply {WeakGive:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to the leftmost enemy.
THREE_KINGDOMS-EN_YUAN.title: Enmity
THREE_KINGDOMS-FAN_KUI.title: Feedback
THREE_KINGDOMS-FAN_KUI.description: This turn, whenever you are attacked, the enemy loses 1 [gold]Strength[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-FU_JI.title: Talisman Aid
THREE_KINGDOMS-FU_JI.description: Discard cards equal to the current [gold]number of enemies[/gold]. For this combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] all [gold]Skill and Attack[/gold] cards in your deck.
THREE_KINGDOMS-GUO_HE_CHAI_QIAO.title: Dismantlement
THREE_KINGDOMS-GUO_SE.title: Beauty
THREE_KINGDOMS-GUO_SE.description: Discard your entire [gold]Hand[/gold]. Add {IfUpgraded:show:a 0-cost [gold]Indulgence[/gold]|an [gold]Indulgence[/gold]} with [gold]Exhaust[/gold] and [gold]Ethereal[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-HAN_YONG.title: Valor
THREE_KINGDOMS-HAN_YONG.description: Draw 2 cards. Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and 1 [gold]Wine[/gold]. Apply {RanAmount:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold] to yourself.
THREE_KINGDOMS-HAN_ZHAN.title: Fierce Battle
THREE_KINGDOMS-HAN_ZHAN.description: Both you and the enemy gain X [gold]Strength[/gold]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to it X times.
THREE_KINGDOMS-HE_YUN.title: Harmonize
THREE_KINGDOMS-HE_YUN.description: Remove the leftmost [gold]Buff[/gold] or [gold]Debuff[/gold] on you. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
THREE_KINGDOMS-HUA_SHEN.title: Incarnation
THREE_KINGDOMS-HUA_SHEN.description: Add 1 random Power card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-HUO_GONG.title: Fire Attack
THREE_KINGDOMS-HUO_JI.title: Fire Stratagem
THREE_KINGDOMS-HUO_JI.description: Deal [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Elemental Damage[/gold] to ALL enemies. Increase this card's damage by {Increase:diff()} for this combat.
THREE_KINGDOMS-HUO_SHA.title: Fire Slash
THREE_KINGDOMS-JIAN_XIONG.title: Wicked Hero
THREE_KINGDOMS-JIAN_XIONG.description: Whenever you take damage, gain 1 Slash from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-JIAN_YING.title: Entrench
THREE_KINGDOMS-JIAN_YING.description: Whenever the card you play is a different [gold]type[/gold] than the previous card, draw 1 card.
THREE_KINGDOMS-JIE_JIE.title: Admonition
THREE_KINGDOMS-JIE_JIE.description: Put all [gold]Skill[/gold] cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-JIE_YING.title: Camp Raid
THREE_KINGDOMS-JIE_YING.description: The enemy gains 2 [gold]Strength[/gold]. Next turn it loses all [gold]Strength[/gold], and you gain that [gold]Strength[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-JIU.title: Wine
THREE_KINGDOMS-JIU.description: Heal {Heal:diff()} HP. Your next Attack deals double damage.
THREE_KINGDOMS-JI_LI.title: Caltrops
THREE_KINGDOMS-JI_LI.description: Whenever you play the Xth card in a turn, draw X cards.
THREE_KINGDOMS-JI_MIE.title: Annihilation
THREE_KINGDOMS-JI_MIE.description:
Deal [gold]Elemental Damage[/gold] to an enemy equal to its [gold]Max HP[/gold]. [gold]Can only be played if you have played {AttackNeedPlayed:diff()} Attacks this turn.[/gold]
[blue]{AttackPlayed:diff()}[/blue] Attacks already played this turn.
THREE_KINGDOMS-JI_XI.title: Sudden Raid
THREE_KINGDOMS-JI_XI.description:
Discard 1 card. Apply {WeakGive:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies. Gain [gold]Strength[/gold] equal to the number of enemies.
[gold]End your turn.[/gold]
THREE_KINGDOMS-JUE_DOU.title: Duel
THREE_KINGDOMS-JUE_DOU.description: If the target enemy's intent is not an attack, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to it.
THREE_KINGDOMS-JUE_JIN.title: Final Resolve
THREE_KINGDOMS-JUE_JIN.description: Gain {BlockGet:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Exhaust[/gold] all Dodges, Peaches and Wines in your [gold]Hand[/gold], [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and [gold]Discard Pile[/gold]. Gain {BlockExtraGet:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each card [gold]Exhausted[/gold] this way. Each turn, add a 0-cost [gold]Wine[/gold] with [gold]Ethereal[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-JU_GU.title: Magnate
THREE_KINGDOMS-JU_GU.description: Increase your [gold]Hand[/gold] size by 3 this combat.
THREE_KINGDOMS-JU_SHOU.title: Hold the Line
THREE_KINGDOMS-KANG_KAI.title: Generosity
THREE_KINGDOMS-KUANG_GU.title: Frenzy
THREE_KINGDOMS-KUANG_GU.description: Set your HP to 1. This turn, whenever you play a Slash or Fire Slash, heal 8 HP, draw 1 card, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, and gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-KU_ROU.title: Self-Mutilation
THREE_KINGDOMS-LEI_JI.title: Thunder Strike
THREE_KINGDOMS-LEI_JI.description: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] the first [gold]Dodge[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold], then deal {Damage:diff()} [gold]Elemental Damage[/gold] 3 times.
THREE_KINGDOMS-LE_BU_SI_SHU.title: Indulgence
THREE_KINGDOMS-LE_BU_SI_SHU.description: Make 1 enemy skip its current turn.
THREE_KINGDOMS-LIANG_YIN.title: Good Match
THREE_KINGDOMS-LIANG_YIN.description: Choose any number of cards to discard. Draw 1 card. Next turn, choose that many cards from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] and add them into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-LIANG_YIN.selectionScreen: Choose any number of cards to discard.
THREE_KINGDOMS-LIAN_HUAN.title: Chain
THREE_KINGDOMS-LIAN_HUAN.description: Discard 1 card. Apply {WeakGive:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to every enemy that is not [gold]Chained[/gold]. Then make ALL enemies [gold]Chained[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-LIE_GONG.title: Fierce Bow
THREE_KINGDOMS-LIE_GONG.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the enemy's HP is greater than or equal to yours, deal it again.
THREE_KINGDOMS-LIE_JIU.title: Strong Wine
THREE_KINGDOMS-LIE_JIU.description: Lose 1 HP. This turn, your next 2 Attacks deal double damage.
THREE_KINGDOMS-LIE_REN.title: Fierce Blade
THREE_KINGDOMS-LIE_REN.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Add a [gold]0-cost[/gold] [gold]Savage Assault[/gold] with [gold]Exhaust[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-LONG_NU.title: Dragon's Wrath
THREE_KINGDOMS-LONG_NU.description: Lose 3 HP. Discard your entire [gold]Hand[/gold]. Add that many [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Fire Slash+|Fire Slash}[/gold] with [gold]Exhaust[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. They are free to play this turn.
THREE_KINGDOMS-LUAN_JI.title: Wild Volley
THREE_KINGDOMS-LUAN_JI.description: Discard 2 cards. Add a 0-cost [gold]Archery Attack[/gold] with [gold]Exhaust[/gold] and [gold]Ethereal[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-LUO_YI.title: Bare Chest
THREE_KINGDOMS-LU_LIAN.title: Chained Slaughter
THREE_KINGDOMS-LU_LIAN.description: Make ALL enemies [gold]Chained[/gold]. Draw 1 card. Deal {Damage:diff()} [gold]Elemental Damage[/gold] to the enemy with the highest HP.
THREE_KINGDOMS-MOU_LIE_GONG.title: Volley of Wrath
THREE_KINGDOMS-MOU_LIE_GONG.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. This card's damage is doubled for each Attack played this turn, up to 4 times. Base damage is unaffected by [gold]Strength[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-NAN_MAN_RU_QIN.title: Savage Assault
THREE_KINGDOMS-NAN_MAN_RU_QIN.descriptio: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies whose intent is not an attack.
THREE_KINGDOMS-PO_JUN.title: Army Breaker
THREE_KINGDOMS-PO_JUN.description: Apply {WeakGive:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold]. Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each [gold]Weak[/gold] on the enemy.
THREE_KINGDOMS-QIANG_XI.title: Assault
THREE_KINGDOMS-QIAO_SHI.title: Gather Firewood

THREE_KINGDOMS-QIN_ZHENG.title: Diligent Rule

THREE_KINGDOMS-QI_ZHENG_XIANG_SHENG.desc: If the enemy's intent is an attack: draw 1 card and apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to it. Otherwise: deal {Damage:diff()} damage and gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
THREE_KINGDOMS-QUE_DI.title: Repulse
THREE_KINGDOMS-QUE_DI.description: Lose 3 [gold]Max HP[/gold]. {IfUpgraded:show:Draw 1 card. }Discard 1 card. Double your damage this turn.
THREE_KINGDOMS-RUN_WEI.title: Subtle Grace
THREE_KINGDOMS-RUN_WEI.description: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Choose any number to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold] and [gold]discard the rest[/gold]. Gain 6 [gold]Block[/gold] for each card discarded.
THREE_KINGDOMS-RUN_WEI.selectionScreenPr: Choose any number of cards to discard.
THREE_KINGDOMS-SHA.title: Slash
THREE_KINGDOMS-SHAN.title: Dodge
THREE_KINGDOMS-SHAN.description: Automatically played when you would take damage. Negate that damage.
THREE_KINGDOMS-SHAN_JIA.title: Mend Armor
THREE_KINGDOMS-SHAN_JIA.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Draw cards equal to the turn number (up to 3).
THREE_KINGDOMS-SHEN_PEI.title: Divine Grace
THREE_KINGDOMS-SHEN_PEI.description: Deal [gold]Elemental Damage[/gold] equal to the HP you have lost this combat ([blue]{HpLost:diff()}[/blue] HP lost this combat so far).
THREE_KINGDOMS-SHEN_ZHU.title: Divine Fixation
THREE_KINGDOMS-SHEN_ZHU.description: If you have a [gold]Slash[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold], discard the first [gold]Slash[/gold], deal {Damage:diff()} damage, and draw 1 card. Otherwise, draw {Cards:diff()} cards and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] this card.
THREE_KINGDOMS-SHUN_SHOU_QIAN_YANG.title: Snatch
THREE_KINGDOMS-SHUN_SHOU_QIAN_YANG.descr: This turn, gain {StrengthGet:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and the enemy loses {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-SI_ZI.title: Zhong Hui - Unbridled
THREE_KINGDOMS-SI_ZI.description: The next X turns, your [gold]Attack[/gold] cards deal {Bonus:diff()} additional damage and your [gold]Basic[/gold] cards cost 1 less.
THREE_KINGDOMS-TAN_FENG.title: Vanguard Probe
THREE_KINGDOMS-TAN_FENG.description:
Draw 2 cards. Deal {Damage:diff()} [gold]Elemental Damage[/gold].
[gold]End your turn.[/gold]
THREE_KINGDOMS-TAO.title: Peach
THREE_KINGDOMS-TAO_YUAN_JIE_YI.title: Peach Garden Oath
THREE_KINGDOMS-TIAN_DU.title: Heaven's Envy
THREE_KINGDOMS-TIAN_DU.description: Whenever you take damage, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
THREE_KINGDOMS-TIAN_ZUO.title: Heaven's Aid
THREE_KINGDOMS-TIAN_ZUO.description: Add 4 copies of [gold]Feint and Force[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-TIE_SUO_LIAN_HUAN.title: Iron Chain
THREE_KINGDOMS-TU_SHE.title: Scheming Shot
THREE_KINGDOMS-TU_SHE.description:
Draw cards equal to the number of enemies{IfUpgraded:show: +1}.
Can only be played if there are no [gold]Basic[/gold] cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-TU_XI.title: Raid
THREE_KINGDOMS-TU_XI.description: Discard 2 cards. ALL enemies lose {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold]. Gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] for each enemy.
THREE_KINGDOMS-WANG_LIE.title: Ardent Advance
THREE_KINGDOMS-WANG_LIE.description: Lose 3 HP. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. At the start of your next turn, draw {Cards:diff()} additional cards.
THREE_KINGDOMS-WAN_JIAN_QI_FA.title: Archery Attack
THREE_KINGDOMS-WEI_JING.title: Border Guard
THREE_KINGDOMS-WEI_JING.description: Choose a [gold]Slash[/gold] or [gold]Dodge[/gold] to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It gains [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-WU_GU_FENG_DENG.title: Harvest
THREE_KINGDOMS-WU_GU_FENG_DENG.descripti: Choose 1 card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-WU_GU_FENG_DENG.selection: Choose 1 card to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-WU_XIE_KE_JI.title: Nullification
THREE_KINGDOMS-WU_ZHONG_SHENG_YOU.title: Ex Nihilo
THREE_KINGDOMS-XIE_ZHENG.title: Duress
THREE_KINGDOMS-XIE_ZHENG.description: At the start of your turn, add 1 [gold]At the Gates[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THREE_KINGDOMS-XING_SHANG.title: Mourning
THREE_KINGDOMS-XING_SHANG.description: Whenever an enemy dies, add a random Rare card into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It costs 0 this combat.
THREE_KINGDOMS-XUE_HEN.title: Vengeance
THREE_KINGDOMS-XUE_HEN.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. [gold]Transform[/gold] any number of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Slash+|Slash}[/gold] with [gold]Exhaust[/gold]. Those [gold]Slash[/gold] cards cost 0 this turn.
THREE_KINGDOMS-XUE_HEN.selectionScreenPr: Choose any number of cards to transform.
THREE_KINGDOMS-YAN_CE.title: Deduction
THREE_KINGDOMS-YAN_CE.description: Randomly predict the types of the next 3 cards you play. Whenever you play a card matching the prediction, draw 1 card. After you play 3 cards, based on the number of correct predictions: 0: lose 6 HP. 1: discard 2 cards. 2: draw 1 card. 3: draw 3 cards.
THREE_KINGDOMS-YE_YAN.title: Karmic Flame
THREE_KINGDOMS-YE_YAN.description: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} [gold]Elemental Damage[/gold]. Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each card discarded this turn.
THREE_KINGDOMS-YING_JIA.title: Imperial Escort
THREE_KINGDOMS-YING_JIA.description: Discard 2 cards. End your turn and begin a new turn.
THREE_KINGDOMS-YING_ZI.title: Heroic Bearing
THREE_KINGDOMS-YING_ZI.description: At the start of your turn, draw 1 additional card.
THREE_KINGDOMS-ZHENG_SHUO.title: Legitimacy
THREE_KINGDOMS-ZHENG_SHUO.description: Shuffle all your non-[gold]Exhausted[/gold] cards into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. Draw 4 cards.
THREE_KINGDOMS-ZHEN_WEI.title: Quell the Siege
THREE_KINGDOMS-ZHEN_WEI.description: Discard any number of cards. For each card discarded, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies and apply 1 [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies. If [gold]cards discarded[/gold] is 4 or more, draw 3 cards.
THREE_KINGDOMS-ZHEN_WEI.selectionScreenP: Choose any number of cards to discard.
THREE_KINGDOMS-ZHI_HENG.title: Balance
THREE_KINGDOMS-ZHI_HENG.description: At the start of your turn, discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards.
